description: A memory per site that every OnPage.dev tool writes to, across chats and clients. Open it first when working on a site over time. Pick with mode: open = Open or create the memory, bind it to this chat, get the brief and next steps (default). Needs url. next = The best next steps from everything recorded. timeline = What happened, newest first. note = Record a decision or context. Needs note. forget = Delete the memory (ask the user first). Needs memory_key.

memory_key.description: The memory_key you got when the memory was created.

share_learning.description: Opt in (true) or out (false) of sharing anonymous results: only the fix type and the rounded lift, never the site, URLs or numbers.

name: site_memory
title: Site memory
